{{Quote|It's a mine. Minerals and gasses are mined and used by the Empire or sold for profit. There is limited Imperial presence at the base. Mainly Droidekas.|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Moore]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SwSM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak with Sergeant Moore|Lok}}</ref>}}
An '''Imperial Mine''' had been established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|It was an Imperial labor camp. Obviously not a place known for their safe working conditions...|[[Jinkins]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FJ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Jinkins|Lok}}</ref>}}
The Imperial mine was a underground mining facility located in a remote area of the planet Lok.<ref name="SWG:RtMF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Mine Filter|Lok}}</ref> It was a labor camp operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] where only worked prisonners.<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> The mine was associated to a secret [[Imperial Research Facility (Lok)|Imperial research facility]] on Lok. Hence, the minerals and gasses mined were used by the Empire at the research facility or sold for profit.<ref name="SWG:SwSM" />

Because of a feud between [[General/Legends|General]] [[Otto]], the commander of the [[Imperial Outpost (Lok)|Imperial garrison]] on Lok, and Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in charge of the mine and research facility, there was very little Imperial presence at the mine. In order to prevent General Otto from meddling in their affairs, these officers deployed [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to guard the mine and the research facility instead of requisitioning Otto's troops.<ref name="SWG:SwSM" />

==History==
{{Quote|The droid says the miners hit some sort of gas pocket. The entire work crew had their brains boiled. They survived, but they're crazy. And the droid thinks that some of the Imperial officers were infected too. Any gas that drives Imperials out of their minds is a good thing to have around, so we want some samples of it.|Jinkins, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FJ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Jinkins|Lok}}</ref>}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the miners hit a gas pocket and released a toxic gas in the mine.<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> Since the air filtration system was rather cheap, it did not prevent the gas from infecting the miners.<ref name="SWG:SwSM" /> The gas did not physically injured the miners but affected their brain and eventually made them crazy and very aggressive.<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

During the incident, a group of miners avoided poison contamination and managed to find a starship that they used to flee the mine. However, the ship crashed before the miners were able to escape Lok, without any survivor.<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> A short time later, the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], a criminal organization ruled by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], raided the [[Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout|hideout]] of the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]] where they retrieved an Imperial [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[memory module]].<ref name="SWG:RtDD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Droid Disk|Lok}}</ref> This droid had been present in the ship that escaped the mine and its memory module was still intact despite the crash. The data module revealed the very situation in the mine to the criminals. Nym's chief [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Jinkins]] then decided to obtain a sample of the gas released in the mine to study it and use it as a weapon if possible.<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

Jinkins thus tasked a group of spacers who had recently joined the Lok Revenants with retrieving a sample of toxic gas. The spacers therefore headed to the mine where they had to fight numerous mad and violent miners. Moreover, they were attacked by the Imperial [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] that defended the facility.<ref name="SWG:RtMF" /> During the fight, the Revenants killed several miners of note, [[Raynar Cath]] and [[Wes Riggers]], two enemies of Nym,<ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mine the Miners|Lok}}</ref> as well as the Grand Foreman [[Rel Rogock]] and the mine controller [[Teemu Komo]].<ref name="SWG:OoMM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Out of My Mine|Lok}}</ref> In addition, they stole some crates of mined ore,<ref name="SWG:StMO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Steal the Mined Ore|Lok}}</ref> and extracted DNA samples from the enraged miners in order to study the exact effect of the gas.<ref name="SWG:EDS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Extract DNA Samples|Lok}}</ref> One of the spacer also collected a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] in the mine.<ref name="SWG:RMWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark II}}</ref> Finally, the spacers found the air filtration system of the mine and retrieved a sealed container of the poisonous gas pumped by the filter. They eventually delivered it to Jinkins.<ref name="SWG:RtMF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Mine was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NTP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial Mine was added to the game as part of the so-called "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:NTP" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 3 Notes: 8 October 03|Publish 3]]" on [[October 8]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 3: The Warren">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60890|text=Publish 3: The Warren}}</ref> This questline was later revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
